This is a classic race condition.

When worker 1 finds job 1 (status "pending"), it then hits `await asyncio.sleep(0.01)` which gives control to the event loop. After the sleep, worker 1 sets status to "processing" and returns the job.

But wait - when worker 2 resumes and continues its loop, what happens? Worker 2 is in the middle of `for job in self._jobs.values():`. The dictionary iteration...
